rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 21 (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-096, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-097) names req-900 among the requirements whose content is kept without the prototype's URL shape, keying the view header on the real route and status while dashboard draft rows keep going to the hub; with ruling:sam-2026-10-07 as narrowed (the prototype decides look and feel, never routes), the prototype's look for a draft's review applies at the real service's one draft review route.
outcome: A draft's review, at the real service's one review route (notification-view, reached from the hub's 'Review and submit', with dashboard draft rows still going to the hub), shows the view header keyed on that route and the Draft status: the Draft tag, the reference as heading, 'Date created: <d Month yyyy>', Copy as new, Delete and the Import reference numbers section, and stays editable with a Change link on every card, the 'There is a problem' summary and per-card errors for incomplete sections, and Continue. The 9 October ruling keeps req-900's content and keys the header on the real route and status, and the prototype decides how that page looks; the prototype's separate header-less journey review is a route split the prototype does not decide, so it is set aside. The Back link follows c-143.
